episode_notes.ep18: Starts in the lantern-lit cherry blossom village, sunset and night boat trips across the lake past a long bridge with a hut, then lays out (coarse dirt outline) and starts building a big stone-brick keep/tower complex with a small wooden house in a plains area across the water.
episode_notes.ep24: Windmill at sunset, night farming, boat back to the cherry village, walks along the lantern-lit covered bridge, then lays out and builds a large wooden stable/hall with a stone base and central arch: frame at sunset, walls at night, rain, roof done at night by the end.
episode_notes.ep25: Finishes the wooden stable (roof details at night, interior stalls), horses moved in (one in diamond armor), night walks through the cherry village and over the covered bridge, ends with the finished stable at golden hour and sunset.
